prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because most categories have only a single test.
Adding a new screen at the finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt completion and had to be stopped early.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (5 tests) yielded two significant wins (+3.9% and +4.0% after noise correction), while three showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: -3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Wait Visualizer: Displays an animated desktop companion loading visualizer with estimated spawn countdown on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting stage has median 201s and mean 2336s wait time, and wait_info changes on home stage have previously yielded significant completion wins (+3.9% and +4.0%).)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Hero Journey Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen layout to a full_bleed video-backed hero layout to immerse users before path choice. (why: choose_path step conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration (514s), showing users stall early in onboarding.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Trait Selection Sub-Flow: Inserts a new sub-flow screen 'new_trait_selection' between photo upload and certificate adoption to let users define pet personality. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (66.2%) and users report custom pet creation issues.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Adds an explicit account persistence hint under sign-in options explaining how existing pets will stay connected. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Photo Upload Layout: Reorganizes the upload_photos screen into a two-column side-by-side view with live preview and photo guidelines. (why: Custom pet generation fails or looks wrong for 3 support cases, and adoption stage drops to 66.2%.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Archetype Preview Screen: Adds a new screen 'new_archetype_preview' before choose_path to showcase animated pet archetypes. (why: 76.2% conversion at choose_path indicates a dropoff before path commitment.)
6: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Tip Carousel: Adds a rotating tip carousel component on the waiting screen explaining desktop interactions during generation. (why: Home wait step has median 201s / mean 2336s, and post-onboarding support (3 tickets) shows confusion over pet controls.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Control & Visibility Intro Copy: Updates home_intro headline and body to explicitly explain how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Finish step conversion is 70.9% and support received multiple queries about hiding/talking to the pet post-onboarding.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Friend Selection Stage Redesign: Redesigns pick_friend screen using a stage layout with animated pet interaction previews. (why: Adoption step has a 66.2% conversion rate and takes median 89s / mean 1017s.)
9: [sign_in, incentive] Account Protection Sign-In Incentive: Adds a clear account status badge highlighting cloud save protection on the sign_in screen. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and users express confusion over missing pets after re-signing in.)

scores.note: Home wait_info changes have strong historical performance (+3.9%/+4.0% wins) and address long wait times.
Choose_path redesign targets drop-off, but historical lift for choose_path redesign is modest (+0.9%).
Adding new screens or sub-flows in onboarding consistently harms completion (-8.6% in adoption).
Direct support ticket alignment and cheap config/copy change with positive sign_in hint baseline (+1.6%).
Targets highest drop-off step (adoption 66.2%) supported by user report data and positive historical layout lift (+2.4%).
Inserting a new preview screen is high cost and risks negative completion drop off, matching new screen trends.
Addresses high wait times and support queries; home wait_info has proven history of high positive lift.
Low cost copy tweak addressing post-onboarding support queries and finish drop-off.
Targets adoption drop-off where prior redesign showed strong positive lift (+6.5%), though requires UI rework.
Low cost badge addition directly addressing user confusion around account persistence during sign in.
